assets.caption: EXHIBIT 9-10 Top-Head Nozzle Arrangements
assets.notes: Two hand-drawn sketches each showing an elevation and plan view of a reactor top head. Upper sketch: vessel with MAINTENANCE ACCESS and INLET NOZZLE labels (note: SEE CHAPTER 10, TOWERS), in ELEVATION and PLAN. Lower sketch: top head with MAINTENANCE ACCESS and INLET NOZZLE labels with a 4'/100 MIN clearance dimension, in ELEVATION and PLAN.
